relevance_note: Cohort deep-sequencing study that describes three identifiable affected patients with mosaic TNFAIP3 variants: "Three patients with lymphoproliferation had mosaic variants in TNFAIP3 leading to premature termination and haploinsufficiency (Patient IDs 66, 99, and 507)."
method_note: Read the whole paper manually; a short Python script assembled the JSON from hand-copied spans. No supplementary text is included in the Markdown (Supplemental Tables S1-S8 are not available), so clinical details are limited to Tables 1 and 3 and the text. Scope: only the three affected patients with TNFAIP3 variants (Patient IDs 66, 99, 507) get rows; the other 449 affected patients and 154 healthy individuals are out of scope. cohort_size_as_stated = 452 affected patients (the 154 currently healthy individuals are not counted as patients). Labels: the paper refers to patients by 'Patient ID <n>' (e.g. 'Patient ID 507'), also 'Pt. ID 66', 'Patient 66', 'ID 66'; I used 'Patient ID <n>' throughout, with the Table 1 row as the label span. All TNFAIP3 variants are mosaic in blood (VAF 0.016-0.06 in Table 1); the paper does not say whether they are somatic or gonosomal (germline) mosaic and they were not found in tumour tissue, so they are kept with zygosity 'mosaic'. Patient ID 507 also carries a mosaic MAP3K1 p.Val128Met variant (Table 1, Table 3: UMS), recorded as a second variant row. Ages are taken from the Table 1 'Age' column (unit and time point not stated in the table; the text gives ages in years elsewhere) and recorded as age at last evaluation; they may be age at sampling. disease_label_as_stated is the Table 3 'Clin. Pheno' category, expanded by the table legend. Pathogenicity is the authors' 'Estimated mosaic pathogenicity' (Table 3), expanded by the legend; for 507 Table 3 also lists 'Previous publications of pathogenicity: Germline^34' and the text says the variant 'has been shown to cause germline autoinflammatory disease due to A20 haploinsufficiency.^34'. Variant type for 507 (TNFAIP3 frameshift, MAP3K1 missense) is from the Table 1 section heading rows above the patient's row. The text prints Patient 99's variant as 'p. Asn98Lysfs' and Patient 507's as 'p.Leu147Glnfs'; the table forms are recorded. Cell-type enrichment by ddPCR (66: enriched in peripheral blood T cells, absent in lymph-node T cells; 99: present in PBMC and NK cells, absent from T, B and monocytes) is reported but is not a functional assay of the variant, so functional_evidence_statement is 'not reported'. Patient ID 66's variant was also detected by exome reanalysis in Ghosh et al. ('accompanying manuscript'), which may describe the same patient; this is a companion paper, not an earlier report, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is left null. No treatments, onset ages, ethnicity, inheritance or parental testing are reported for these three patients. No contradictions found.
